hero.headline: Prevention, Education, Integration
hero.subheadline: The Mefo Tuèbu Foundation works towards a more just world by supporting vulnerable communities through education, prevention, and social integration programs.

about.label: Our mission
about.title: Acting together for a dignified future
about.description: Founded on the conviction that every human being deserves a dignified life, the Mefo Tuèbu Foundation (FMT e.V.) develops concrete programs in three fundamental areas: prevention of social risks, access to education, and integration of marginalized populations.
about.value_1_desc: Awareness and support programs to reduce social risks before they become crises.
about.value_2_desc: Access to education for all, regardless of social background, location, or available resources.
about.value_3_desc: Supporting vulnerable people towards full and active participation in society.

projects.label: Our projects
projects.title: Concrete action on the ground
projects.description: Every project is designed with the communities involved, rooted in their realities, and oriented towards sustainable results.
projects.project_1_title: School for All in Sub-Saharan Africa
projects.project_1_desc: Construction and equipping of classrooms in remote areas, teacher training and distribution of school supplies for 500 children.
projects.project_2_desc: Linguistic, administrative, and social support for newly arrived refugee families in Germany, with personalized follow-up.
projects.project_3_desc: Awareness campaigns, access to primary care, and training of health relays in underprivileged neighborhoods.

news.label: News
news.title: Stay informed about our work
news.news_1_excerpt: After 18 months of construction and thanks to the mobilization of our donors, the Ngaoundéré primary school opened its doors to 120 students.
news.news_2_title: New partnership with the German Red Cross
news.news_2_excerpt: FMT e.V. and the DRK join forces to strengthen migrant integration programs in the Cologne region.
news.news_3_excerpt: Our annual report details all actions taken, results achieved, and perspectives for 2025.

events.label: Events
events.title: Join us
events.event_1_desc: Join us for our annual gala evening, a unique opportunity to meet our partners and support our programs.
events.event_2_desc: International roundtable on education challenges in developing countries, featuring renowned speakers.
events.event_3_desc: Run for a good cause! Every kilometer covered directly contributes to funding our educational projects.

partners.label: Partners
partners.title: Organizations that trust us
partners.description: We collaborate with public institutions, international NGOs, and committed companies that share our values.

donate.label: Support
donate.title: Your donation changes lives
donate.description: Every contribution, regardless of the amount, enables the Mefo Tuèbu Foundation to continue and expand its missions in the field.
donate.note: FMT e.V. Foundation is a non-profit organization registered in Germany. Donations are tax-deductible.

footer.legal: FMT e.V. is an association registered in Germany in accordance with German association law.
